title: Multiply in place
prompt: A member `speed` starts at 10. Write `boost`, which multiplies speed by 3 using `*=`. In `speed_after_boost`, call boost. Then return speed, which is 30.
hints: `*=` multiplies a variable and stores the result back.

docs.name: a * b
docs.what: Multiplies two numbers. * with a float keeps decimals.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.
